title: Purchasing Managers Index
definition: The Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) is an economic indicator based on monthly surveys of private sector companies designed to provide an advance indication of economic trends in the manufacturing and services sectors.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (economic indicators, data sources) and Mains GS Paper III (growth, development, industrial output, and monetary policy transmission).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Purchasing Managers Index.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core macroeconomic indicators like GDP, IIP, and CPI
